research_task.title: Test dual coercivity for localized-shear corrections

summary: At derivative order zero, every finite endogenous divergence-free witness family has a pressure-invariant switching--viscous null direction when the logarithmic switch rate is tuned to a generalized viscous eigenvalue; aligned corrections also have exact self and cross nonlinear cancellation.

value_assessment.novelty: The linked prior artifact proves a one-witness viscous gap under affine separation. This result adds the unresolved finite switching matrix and shows that separation from the logarithmic switching rate is also necessary for unconditional coercivity in a finite endogenous witness span; it additionally audits aligned cross-correction pairings.
value_assessment.evidence: A complete derivative-order-zero integration-by-parts matrix derivation and an exact reduced-rational polynomial-cutoff computation establish two zero generalized characteristic determinants, two zero tuned residual columns, the affine matrix, and the zero nonlinear factor.
value_assessment.falsifier: A viscous sign error, failure of positive definiteness under the stated linear-independence assumptions, a nonzero exact characteristic determinant at a recorded eigenvalue, or a nonzero aligned-family nonlinear pairing would overturn the scoped result.

claims.statement: For a finite linearly independent aligned family of compact divergence-free corrections tested against itself at derivative order zero, tuning the logarithmic switch rate to the negative of a generalized viscous eigenvalue makes every switching--viscous witness pairing vanish. All aligned self and cross nonlinear pairings vanish, while the generalized eigenvalue retains an inverse-square transverse contribution.
claims.evidence_summary: Integration by parts gives a positive-definite switching Gram matrix and viscous stiffness matrix, finite-dimensional spectral theory gives the null direction, and exact rational cutoff calculations reproduce the zero determinants and tuned columns.
claims.verification_method: Re-derive the finite pairing matrices and anisotropic scaling, then rerun the exact rational polynomial-cutoff checks of both characteristic determinants, tuned residual columns, affine entries, and the planar nonlinear factor.

limitations: At zero affine strain the cancelling rate is negative, so the result does not obstruct a monotone switch-on schedule.
Only finite endogenous witnesses at derivative order zero are covered; exogenous, adaptive, and higher-derivative witnesses remain open.
Cross cancellation requires a common aligned planar profile, and generic correction families may have nonzero cross terms.
Vanishing of finitely many pairings does not imply vanishing of the residual or its Leray projection.
The exact polynomial surrogate is sufficiently regular for the checked identities but is not the smooth linked radial profile.
failed_approaches: The tensor-product polynomial surrogate does not certify the proposed higher-derivative radial extension, so that extension was excluded from the final claim.
next_actions: Run an exact radial polynomial cutoff audit at derivative orders one and two.
Add one exogenous compact curl witness and test the enlarged smallest singular value under monotone switch-on and affine separation.

proposed_tasks.title: Test an exogenous curl witness against the tuned null mode
proposed_tasks.objective: Augment the endogenous family by one compact divergence-free curl witness and compute the enlarged switching, viscous, affine, nonlinear, and cross-correction matrix.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The proved null direction is confined to the correction-generated witness span, so one exogenous witness is the smallest unresolved escape.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: A scale-uniform positive smallest singular value under explicit monotone-switch and affine-separation assumptions.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: An exact enlarged-matrix null vector or an asymptotically vanishing singular value with every scale power audited.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Derive the enlarged matrix by integration by parts, evaluate exact polynomial determinants, and use interval-certified singular-value bounds if exact factorization is unavailable.
